reviewer.method: Actual view_image inspection of 16 complete labeled three-frame contact sheets, plus all three held-out-spin original PNGs.
reviewer.independence: Reviewer did not run or modify the capture harnesses or product code during this task; this is an AI visual review, not a claimed human sign-off.

summary: All 27 source-force captures and all 21 Agent-force recovery captures were actually inspected, with all 48 SHA256 values matching the identified browser reports.
No blocking rendering or layout concern was observed in these captured states. Visible brown/blue material regions and faceted silhouettes remain present and inside the canvas.
Broad framing gives small subjects in several fixtures. Side views overlap paired forms. These limit visual coverage and do not establish geometry or physics correctness.
nonblocking_visibility_limitations: Fine surface details cannot be assessed reliably in the small-subject captures, especially held-out-spin.
Side views of paired fixtures contain projection overlap and cannot reveal every obscured surface.
claim_boundaries: This record covers the exact two source locations listed in scope, including Agent-force recovery-002. It does not substitute successful evidence for failed or partial earlier executions.
Browser report statuses and provenance are quoted from the identified reports; functional and numerical checks were not reproduced by this reviewer.
Only captured views and reported times were inspected. Controls, motion between samples, camera fit over the entire duration and numerical tolerances are not proved by this visual review.
Screenshots show browser playback of recorded transforms; they do not establish a live force solver, Blender/Unreal import, full language conformance or release readiness.
Fixture identifiers are qualified by their gate; force P11 does not resolve historical planar-reach P11 or other held failures.
No product import, runtime, test, source edit or remote mutation was performed by this review. Raw PNGs were not modified.

limits: Screenshots require separate identified visual review; finite numerical readback alone cannot certify appearance.
This component role validates source-built GLB bytes. It does not establish Agent transport, artifact retrieval or repair protocol acceptance.
The independent native decoder separately checks full topology, winding, materials, force histories and dense intermediate motion of these artifacts.
The offline browser plays recorded transforms; it does not run live force, impulse, contact or torque physics.
Complete F01-F12 acceptance, inherited regression, compatibility and provider-neutral release evidence remain separately executed gates.
